description: Land Title Settlement Department - Boyagama, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320304
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains the Commissioner of Title Settlement's determination regarding specific land parcels (Nos. 208 and 209) in Boyagama village, including detailed ownership information, property extent, and title classification. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
